items.title: 11 Chateau Cir Chesterbrook, PA 19087
items.description: 4-bedroom, 2.5-bathroom townhouse in the Picket Post community of Chesterbrook. This home also has one of the largest layouts in Chesterbrook with four bedrooms and finished basement. As you enter the home, you're welcomed by a foyer with hardwood floors that leads into the inviting living room. This space features hardwood flooring, a cozy corner fireplace, and built-in bookcases, creating the perfect setting for relaxing or gathering with family and friends. The kitchen offers hardwood floors and ample space for a breakfast table, making it ideal for casual dining. Just beyond, the family room provides additional living space with carpeting and sliding glass doors leading to the deck, offering an easy transition for indoor-outdoor entertaining. The adjacent dining room features carpeting, crown molding, and chair rail detailing, and flows seamlessly into the family room for both everyday living and special occasions. A convenient powder room completes the main level. Upstairs, the spacious primary suite includes carpet flooring, a ceiling fan, crown molding, chair rail with wainscoting, and a walk-in closet. The private en-suite bathroom features tile flooring and a step-in shower. Two additional bedrooms, both with carpet flooring, provide comfortable accommodations for family, guests, or a home office. A full hall bathroom with tile flooring and a tub/shower combination, along with a conveniently located laundry closet, completes the second level. The third floor offers a private fourth bedroom with carpet flooring. The finished basement expands the home's living space with a recreation room featuring carpeting, a ceiling fan, and built-in cabinetry, making it ideal for a media room, play area, or additional entertainment space. A separate utility and storage room adds extra functionality. Property comes with one reserved parking space. Located next to 355 Chase Road, this home will benefit from the township's upcoming community space, which is planned to include recreational courts and a pavilion. You are also conveniently near local shopping, grocery stores, restaurants, entertainment, and major commuter routes. Kitchen upgrades are planned for this coming November/ December.

items.title: 3000 N 21st St Philadelphia, PA 19132
items.description: This prime 0.02-acre corner lot offers a level terrain, ideal for building your next ideal property. Located in a growing area, the lot presents an excellent opportunity for mixed-use development. The street view provides visibility and accessibility for commercial building. With the increasing demand for housing, this property is positioned for appreciation, making it a strategic addition to any investment portfolio. Take advantage of this rare opportunity to secure a valuable piece of land in a desirable location, perfect for capitalizing on the booming real estate market. Don't miss out on the potential this lot holds for future growth and profitability.

items.title: 1017 Kennett Way West Chester, PA 19380
items.description: Welcome to 1017 Kennett Way. This 3-bedroom, 3-bath home offers easy one-level living plus a finished lower level in the sought-after 55+ community of Hershey's Mill in West Chester. Beautiful landscaping leads to the front door, and the entire home has been freshly repainted. Inside, a welcoming foyer with coat closet opens to the main living spaces, where hardwood floors and crown molding add warmth and character. The light-filled dining room features skylights, while the eat-in kitchen offers upgraded cabinetry and countertops, stainless steel appliances, a pantry, and ceiling fan. The living room features a wood-burning fireplace and sliding doors to the deck overlooking the community golf course, a peaceful spot to relax and unwind. French doors open from the living room to a private office/den. A main-level laundry closet with washer and dryer hookups adds everyday convenience. The primary suite includes a ceiling fan, walk-in closet, French doors to the deck, and a vanity area with sink. The en-suite bath features tile flooring, skylight, single vanity, and tub/shower combination. A second bedroom with crown molding and a full hall bath with step-in shower complete the main level. The finished lower level provides additional living space and flexibility, with a chair lift providing convenient access between levels. The family room features French doors leading to the yard, while a third bedroom with a triple window offers a comfortable private retreat. A full bath with tub/shower combination is located nearby. A spacious cedar closet provides excellent seasonal storage, while two large storage areas with built-in shelving offer abundant room for belongings, hobbies, or workshop space. One storage area also includes a second laundry area, utility sink, and the home's utilities. A detached, extra-deep garage and two parking spaces right outside the home make coming and going easy. Life at Hershey's Mill means maintenance-free living with 24/7 gated and guarded security, an 18-hole golf course, and more than 35 active clubs. Residents enjoy a sports complex with tennis, pickleball, platform tennis, bocce, shuffleboard, billiards, and table tennis, plus a large heated community pool, a community center, a library, a wood shop, a community garden, a dog exercise area, a private community bus, and even an on-site TV station. You're also just a short drive from shopping, dining, and everything downtown West Chester has to offer. Don't miss the chance to make this home yours!

items.title: 2105 Melvin St Philadelphia, PA 19131
items.description: Welcome to 2105 Melvin Street, an investor opportunity in Wynnefield! This two-unit brick duplex offers solid bones and a chance to add value with cosmetic updates, sold as-is. Both units share a front foyer. The first-floor unit features a living room, a dining room, a kitchen, and a half bath, plus access to the full basement with a full bathroom, adding valuable extra space. The second-floor unit offers a bedroom, a full bathroom, and its own kitchen. The property is structurally solid and needs cosmetic repair, and the heating system will need to be replaced. Gas heat and hot water, public water and sewer, and wood floors are already in place. Set on a quiet residential block in Wynnefield, the home is convenient to City Avenue, Fairmount Park, and public transportation, with easy access to Center City. Bring your vision and your contractor, and make this a strong addition to your portfolio.

items.title: 2304 Nicholas St Philadelphia, PA 19121
items.description: Welcome to 2304 Nicholas Street. This beautifully renovated brick rowhome blends classic Philadelphia character with modern updates throughout. Arched windows and a leaded-glass transom over the front door set the tone from the street. Step inside the entry vestibule to brand new flooring that flows throughout the home. The bright living room features recessed lighting and a striking decorative fireplace with a navy mantel and marble-look surround, while a navy-painted staircase with white spindles adds a bold, historic touch. The living room opens to a designer eat-in kitchen with white shaker cabinetry, gold hardware, stone countertops, a navy subway tile backsplash, and open corner shelving. Brand new stainless steel appliances, including a gas range, complete the space, and an island with seating leaves plenty of room for a dining table. A powder room with a window and a mudroom/laundry area with a brand new washer and dryer and a door to the yard finish the main level. Upstairs, the primary bedroom is a showstopper, with two arched leaded-glass windows, a ceiling fan with light, and a stunning built-in wardrobe with cabinets and drawers. The second bedroom also offers a ceiling fan with light, and the third bedroom features a ceiling fan with light and a decorative fireplace mantel. The modern full bath features tile, a single-sink vanity, and a step-in shower. Natural light fills the home throughout, and you can even catch a view of Liberty Place from an upstairs window. Out back, a fenced patio offers a private spot to relax or grill. The location is hard to beat. You're within walking distance of grocery stores, local shops, restaurants, and public transportation, near Girard College, with easy access to I-76 and a quick trip to Center City.

items.title: 109 Thissell Ln Wilmington, PA 19807
items.description: Welcome to 109 Thissell Lane. Build your vision on this private, wooded 1.3-acre lot in The Meadows community of Pennsbury Township, set within the award-winning Unionville-Chadds Ford School District. The land rises gently from the street and levels out at the top, where you'll find flat, open areas surrounded by mature trees and natural foliage. It's a peaceful, private setting with wooded views in every direction, offering a wonderful opportunity to design a custom home in one of Chester County's most sought-after areas. The lot is zoned residential. Public water and sewer are not available, so buyers should plan for private well and septic, subject to the necessary approvals. While the majority of the lot sits in Pennsylvania and Chester County, the street frontage is in Delaware, which is why the property carries a Wilmington mailing address. Enjoy the best of the Brandywine Valley, with scenic back roads, local parks, and the shops and restaurants of Chadds Ford and Wilmington just a short drive away.

items.title: 1303 N 7th St Philadelphia, PA 19122
items.description: Available now! Large house in greater center city with attached GARAGE parking and a large backyard. Only a couple blocks from Northern Liberties, this 4-bedroom/2-bath rowhome is a rare offering. Built in 2008, this clean contemporary home features central A/C, dual pane windows, stylish kitchen with stainless appliances, and plenty of storage. The downstairs includes garage, laundry room with newer washer and dryer, a bedroom and full bath, and access to the generous backyard. The second story with hardwood floors and bay window is the main living level, including pantry storage, additional closet, cordless blinds, dining area, and updated kitchen with dishwasher and garbage disposal. Charming peninsula with bar seating. The top story has three bedrooms, each with updated ceiling fans, generous closets, and dual pane windows. The full bathroom has been updated and completes the very sensible floorplan. Mere blocks to some of the most beloved restaurants and cafes in Northern Liberties and Fishtown, and convenient grocery stores nearby. The charming vintage restored G trolleys roll down Girard Ave, ready to connect you to Fairmount, the zoo, Fishtown, and other major transit hubs. With an attached garage and secure off-street parking, driving in the city has never been easier! Come see the best lifestyle available in this price point, ready for Oct 1 start date.

items.title: 233 Leon Ave Norwood, PA 19074
items.description: Welcome to 233 Leon Ave, a 3-bedroom, 1.5-bath twin home in Norwood, PA, within the Interboro School District. Originally remodeled in 2019, with fresh updates completed in 2026, this home offers a comfortable blend of modern updates, functional living space, and outdoor convenience. Step inside to an open-concept first floor featuring high ceilings, recessed lighting, vinyl flooring, and plenty of natural light. The kitchen's hardwood continues through the main living zones and includes a large granite island, stainless appliances, gas cooktop, soft closing cabinet doors, under-cabinet and recessed lighting, pantry space, plus a butler's pantry and wet bar. A bright breakfast room and a sunroom (hardwood, vaulted ceiling) provide casual dining and direct access to the two-tier deck. Main-level conveniences include a mudroom (hardwood) and a tile-floored laundry room. A private main-level bedroom suite with carpet and an attached full tile bath is ideal for guests or extended family. Upstairs, the expansive primary suite offers carpeting, tray ceiling, recessed lighting, two walk-in closets and a primary bath with tile flooring, double vanities, jetted tub and separate shower. A large loft/game room plus three additional bedrooms each with generous dimensions and walk-in closets provide comfortable family living and access to full baths. The walk-out basement (insulated walls, drywall ceiling, spare room, sump pump) adds storage and future finished-space potential. Outside, enjoy a private treed backyard and two-tier deck, stucco-and-siding exterior, and excellent curb appeal. Convenient to Routes 1 & 202 and a short drive to Unionville High School, downtown West Chester, Longwood Gardens as well as downtown Kennett Square, 132 Pratt Lane offers spacious, move-in ready living in a sought???after location.

items.title: 2201 E Huntingdon St Philadelphia, PA 19125
items.description: Welcome to 2201 Huntingdon Street, a 3-unit multi-family triplex in Philadelphia offering a great opportunity for an investor or buyer looking to build their rental portfolio. Set on a corner lot with abundant natural light throughout, this property features three separate 1-bedroom, 1-bathroom units, along with shared laundry and outdoor patio space. The first unit offers an open-concept living room and kitchen layout with stainless steel appliances and space for a small island or breakfast bar. The bedroom receives plenty of natural light, and the full bathroom includes tile flooring, a single sink vanity, and a step-in shower. The second unit features a kitchen located just off the entry, complete with tile flooring and stainless steel appliances. A full bathroom with a step-in shower sits nearby, while the bright living room and separate bedroom provide a functional layout for everyday living. The third-level unit includes a spacious kitchen with stainless steel appliances, an open living and dining area with great natural light, a full bathroom with a tub/shower combination and single sink vanity, and a bedroom with multiple windows. The property also includes a shared laundry room on the first level with access to a shared patio, adding convenience for residents. The building is currently fully leased, with all tenants on month-to-month leases, offering flexibility for the next owner. Located in a lively Philadelphia neighborhood near local restaurants, cafes, entertainment, public transportation, and everyday amenities, this property offers strong rental appeal and long-term potential. Whether you are looking to expand your investment portfolio, live in one unit while renting the others, or reposition a multi-unit property in a convenient city location, 2201 Huntingdon Street is an opportunity worth seeing.

items.title: 855 Martin Ave Bryn Mawr, PA 19010
items.description: Welcome to 855 Martin Ave., a 2-bedroom, 2-bath home situated on a corner lot in the desirable Bryn Mawr neighborhood, complete with a 2-car garage. Being sold as-is, this property offers a fantastic opportunity for investors, renovators, or buyers looking to make it their own. Step inside to the living room, featuring carpet flooring and a ceiling fan, creating a comfortable space to relax. The adjoining dining room also offers carpet flooring and convenient access to a full bathroom with tile flooring and a walk-in shower. Just beyond the dining room, the kitchen is equipped with an electric oven, dishwasher, refrigerator, and range hood. A first-floor laundry area adds everyday convenience. Upstairs, you'll find two carpeted bedrooms and a second full bathroom with tile flooring and a tub/shower combination. Outside, enjoy the patio overlooking a private backyard with a storage shed, providing additional storage space. Ideally located near township parks, Bryn Mawr Hospital, Haverford College, and everything the Main Line has to offer, this home also provides convenient access to public transportation, shopping, and the restaurants along Lancaster Avenue. Whether you're looking for your next renovation project or an investment opportunity, don't miss your chance to make this property your own!

items.title: 8 Long Dr Downingtown, PA 19335
items.description: Welcome to 8 Long Drive, a beautiful move-in ready 4-bedroom, 2.5-bathroom single family home in the desirable Whitford community. Featuring a new roof, new HVAC system, spacious living areas, and a flexible finished basement, this home offers comfort, functionality, and plenty of room to gather, relax, and entertain. As you approach the home, you are welcomed by an inviting front yard, a side-entry 2-car garage, and a spacious driveway with parking for approximately five additional vehicles. Step inside to an open foyer with hardwood flooring and a staircase leading to the upper level. To the right of the foyer, the living room features carpet flooring and two bright front-facing windows that fill the space with natural light. The dining room offers a lovely chandelier, a wood-framed window, chair rail detailing, and carpet flooring, creating a warm setting for everyday meals, holiday dinners, and special gatherings. Continue into the kitchen, where hardwood floors, Corian countertops, an electric oven, stainless steel microwave and refrigerator, a double sink with garbage disposal, and a bright ceiling light create a functional space for daily cooking. An opening connects the kitchen to the breakfast room, which features hardwood flooring and a double window overlooking the backyard. From there, the layout flows into the family room, the heart of the home, featuring carpet flooring, a brick fireplace with a wood mantel, and sliding glass doors leading to the wood deck with steps down to the yard. The main level also includes a practical mudroom with tile flooring, chair rail, a utility sink, cabinets, and shelving for added storage. A convenient powder room with hardwood flooring, a single sink vanity, cabinet storage, and a fan completes the first floor. Upstairs, the upper level features all-new carpeting and a spacious hallway linen closet. The primary bedroom offers a walk-in closet, plus an additional closet along the hallway leading to the en-suite bathroom. The primary bathroom features tile flooring, double sinks, a soaking tub, and a skylight that brings in natural light. Three additional bedrooms, each with carpeting and bright natural light, provide comfortable accommodations for family, guests, or a home office. A full hall bathroom with double sinks, tile flooring, and a linen closet completes this level. The finished basement expands the home's living space with two distinct areas. One section offers a game room with carpeting, windows, and a ceiling fan, while the great room features a propane fireplace and plenty of space for relaxing, entertaining, or movie nights. An additional office with a walk-in closet provides valuable flexibility for working from home, hobbies, guests, or additional storage. Outside, the deck creates a comfortable outdoor space for dining, entertaining, or enjoying the backyard. Don't wait to make 8 Long Dr your new home!

items.title: 1438 Williamsburg Dr West Chester, PA 19382
items.description: Welcome to 1438 Williamsburg Drive, a rare opportunity to own 1.3 acres of level, corner lot land in the highly desirable Pocopson Creek community of West Chester. Located within the sought-after Unionville-Chadds Ford School District, this parcel offers an exceptional setting for a future custom home or long-term investment. The lot carries a separate tax ID from the residence at the same address. Enjoy the peace and privacy of a residential setting while remaining just minutes from local shops, farmers markets, and restaurants, with a short drive to downtown West Chester. Opportunities like this combining location, school district, and usable land are increasingly rare. Don't miss your chance to secure a prime piece of Chester County real estate.

items.title: 7023 Clover Ln Upper Darby, PA 19082
items.description: Welcome to 7023 Clover Lane, a 3-bedroom, 1.5-bathroom rowhome in Drexel Hill offering a practical layout and an excellent opportunity to make it your own. As you approach the home, you'll be greeted by a covered front porch leading to the front entrance. Inside, the living room features luxury vinyl plank flooring and flows seamlessly into the dining room, which continues with the same flooring and includes a ceiling fan with light. The kitchen offers a peninsula overlooking the dining area, creating an open feel between the spaces, along with a door providing access to the rear deck. A convenient powder room completes the main level. Upstairs, you'll find three bedrooms, all featuring luxury vinyl plank flooring. The additional bedrooms offer flexibility for family, guests, or a home office. The full hall bathroom includes tile flooring and a tub/shower combination. The lower level features a partially finished basement with additional living or storage potential, along with a dedicated laundry area. A door from the basement provides access to the rear parking space located beneath the back deck. Conveniently located near local shopping, grocery stores, restaurants, parks, and everyday amenities, this home offers a great opportunity for buyers looking to add their own personal touches in a desirable Drexel Hill location. Don't miss the chance to make 7023 Clover Lane your next home.

items.title: 136 Bridge St #302 Phoenixville, PA 19460
items.description: Experience luxury downtown living in this stunning bi-level penthouse located right in the heart of Phoenixville on Bridge Street! This rare 2-bedroom, 2.5-bathroom residence feels like a townhome, featuring a wide-open main floor with engineered hardwood floors, a bright kitchen, and private bedrooms tucked away on the second level. Includes secure, designated parking - a premium commodity for downtown living! As you arrive, you'll appreciate the convenience of a deeded parking space located directly next to the rear entrance and elevator, making everyday errands and grocery runs effortless. The pet-friendly community is also adjacent to a park and green space, adding to the appeal for both residents and their four-legged companions. The kitchen features cherry cabinetry, stainless steel appliances, a peninsula with seating, and ample workspace for cooking and entertaining. The adjoining dining area flows seamlessly into the bright living room, where large double windows fill the space with natural light. A coat closet and conveniently located powder room complete the main level. Upstairs, the primary suite features newer carpeting, a large double window, and a private en-suite bathroom. The second bedroom, also with newer carpeting, offers flexible space for guests, a home office, or both, and enjoys views overlooking the adjoining rooftop and surrounding neighborhood. A second full bathroom and laundry area complete the upper level. For added peace of mind, the home features a high-efficiency HVAC system that was replaced approximately five years ago. Residents of Renaissance Place East enjoy a truly low-maintenance lifestyle with HOA services covering common area maintenance, elevator maintenance, snow removal, trash service, and exterior and structural maintenance. The location is where this home truly shines. Step outside and enjoy Phoenixville's renowned restaurants, breweries, coffee shops, boutiques, community events, and seasonal festivals. The Schuylkill River Trail and nearby parks are just moments away, while Routes 422 and 202 provide convenient access to King of Prussia, Malvern, and beyond. Whether you're meeting friends for dinner, enjoying a weekend festival, or heading out for a morning walk, this home places you in the center of one of the region's most sought-after downtown destinations. Don't miss the opportunity to make 136 Bridge Street, Unit 302 your new home.

items.title: 224 Hearn Ave Berwyn, PA 19312
items.description: Welcome to 224 Hearn Avenue, a 4-bedroom, 2.5-bathroom single family home in Berwyn, located within the award-winning Tredyffrin-Easttown School District. Offering spacious living areas, timeless finishes, and a functional layout, this home is designed for both everyday living and effortless entertaining. As you approach the home, a 2-car garage and 2-car driveway provide ample parking and lead to the inviting front entrance. Step inside to a dramatic two-story foyer featuring hardwood floors, a chandelier, chair rail with wainscoting, and access to a convenient powder room and coat closet. To the left, the private home office offers hardwood flooring and a bright double front window, creating the perfect work-from-home space. To the right, the formal living room features hardwood floors and abundant natural light, with an arched entry leading into the elegant dining room. The dining room is highlighted by hardwood flooring, an octagonal tray ceiling, crown molding, and chair rail with wainscoting, providing a beautiful setting for hosting family and friends. At the heart of the home is the well-appointed kitchen, featuring tile flooring, granite countertops, an island with seating, a gas cooktop with a range hood vented to the exterior, a pantry closet, and a double sink. The kitchen opens to the breakfast room, complete with tile floors, a chandelier, and a half wall overlooking the family room, creating an open and connected feel throughout the main living spaces. Just off the breakfast area, the laundry room includes tile flooring, a utility sink, washer and dryer, home alarm system controls, and convenient access to the garage. The family room serves as a warm and inviting gathering space with hardwood floors, a semi-vaulted ceiling, ceiling fan with light, and a stunning floor-to-ceiling stone fireplace and a perfect TV niche. A door from the family room leads to the composite deck, offering a convenient outdoor retreat for relaxing or entertaining while overlooking the backyard. Upstairs, the spacious primary suite features a double-door entry, tray ceiling, ceiling fan with light, carpeting, and a large walk-in closet. The luxurious en-suite bathroom includes tile flooring, a private water closet, double sink vanity with granite countertops, a tiled step-in shower with bench seating, a tiled jetted soaking tub, a linen closet, and a second walk-in closet. Three additional bedrooms, all with carpeting, provide comfortable accommodations for family, guests, or additional office space. A full hall bathroom with tile flooring, a single sink vanity, and a tub/shower combination completes the second level. The finished lower level offers exceptional flexibility with a large recreation room, making it ideal for a media room, play area, home gym, or additional gathering space. A utility room provides added storage and functionality. Conveniently located near local shopping, grocery stores, restaurants, entertainment, and more, this home offers the perfect combination of comfort, style, and convenience. Don't miss the opportunity to make 224 Hearn Avenue your new home.

items.title: 1223 Hagys Ford Rd Penn Valley, PA 19072
items.description: Welcome to 1223 Hagys Ford Road, a stunning 4-bedroom, 3-bath contemporary split-level home set on 1.04 beautifully landscaped acres in Penn Valley. The outdoor living spaces are truly exceptional, creating a private backyard retreat designed for both relaxation and entertaining. Surrounded by mature landscaping, the expansive wraparound deck overlooks the in-ground heated chlorine pool and charming gazebo, offering the perfect setting for summer gatherings, peaceful mornings, or evenings spent enjoying the serene surroundings. Located directly across from Welsh Valley Middle School, this home combines architectural character, spacious living areas, and exceptional indoor-outdoor living in one of the Main Line's most desirable locations. As you enter the home, you're welcomed by a bright foyer that flows into the expansive main living spaces. The dining room offers hardwood floors, recessed lighting, and French doors leading to the wraparound deck, making it ideal for both everyday living and entertaining. The living room is filled with natural light and features hardwood flooring, recessed lighting, and a wood fireplace with a classic mantel, creating a warm and inviting atmosphere. Just beyond, the family room is a standout space with slate flooring, exposed ceiling beams, partially vaulted ceilings, and a fireplace that adds warmth and character. Large windows and open sightlines give the home an airy and contemporary feel throughout. The kitchen is thoughtfully designed with granite countertops, stainless steel appliances, recessed lighting, a peninsula with seating, gas cooking, built-in microwave, pantry closet, and generous prep space. Heated floors extend throughout the kitchen and adjoining sunroom, adding an extra touch of comfort and luxury. Adjacent to the kitchen, the spacious sunroom features skylights, track lighting, and two sliding glass doors leading to the deck, creating seamless indoor-outdoor living while overlooking the private backyard oasis. Upstairs, the primary suite offers vaulted ceilings, hardwood flooring, a spacious walk-in closet, and views overlooking the family room fireplace area below. The primary bathroom creates a spa-like retreat with heated tile floors, double vanities, a soaking jetted tub, and a separate glass-enclosed shower. Three additional bedrooms provide flexibility for family, guests, or home office needs. A full hall bathroom with tile flooring and a tub and shower combination serves the secondary bedrooms. Set on over an acre of land, this property offers a rare combination of privacy, space, and convenience in the heart of the Main Line. You are also conveniently located near local shopping, restaurants, parks, and more, with easy access to I-76 for commuting to Center City Philadelphia and beyond. Don't miss the opportunity to make 1223 Hagys Ford Road your next home.

items.description: Welcome to 1141 Thomas Street, a 3-bedroom, 1-bath rowhome in Chester. One bedroom and the full bathroom have already been updated, featuring tile flooring and a tiled shower. The remaining space provides a solid starting point for further improvements and added value. Conveniently located near local parks, shopping, Widener University, and with easy access to I-95, this property offers both potential and accessibility. Don't miss the opportunity to make 1141 Thomas Street your next project.
